reports.headline: Something Nesting in the Empty House
reports.body: The house {dir} of the village {dist} that nobody lives in has a black stone growing through its floor, and it pulses like a heart. {name} saw a swollen thing tending it, and lean shapes guarding the door.

reports.headline: The House That Breathes
reports.body: {name} swears the empty house {dir} of here {dist} breathes at night. Inside, {they} saw a dark stone standing where the hearth should be, and things guarding it that hissed when the lamp came near.
